post.summary: Register signing secret for HMAC verification
post.description:
Register an on-prem signing secret (`opm_xxx`) for HMAC verification.

    Call once before sending telemetry (optional — the first batch auto-
    registers). The secret is encrypted at rest. `cmp_` API keys are rejected:
    the on-prem image generates its own `opm_` credential on start, so upgrade
    the image rather than supplying one by hand.

    **Required Headers:**
    - `X-API-Key`: Your Compresr API key

    **Body:**
    - `signing_secret`: On-prem signing secret (`opm_xxx`)
    - `instance_id`: Optional instance identifier

409.description: Secret already registered to a different account. Retrying cannot clear this; generate a new secret for this deployment.

post.summary: Ingest telemetry batch from on-prem instance
post.description:
Receive and store a batch of telemetry events from an on-prem Compresr instance.
    
    **Required Headers:**
    - `X-API-Key`: Compresr API key (authentication)
    - `X-Compresr-Signature`: HMAC signature (integrity)
    
    **Optional Headers:**
    - `X-Instance-ID`: On-prem instance identifier
    
    **First Request (auto-registration):**
    Include `signing_secret` (`opm_xxx`) in the body - it will be registered
    automatically. The on-prem image generates this credential itself; `cmp_`
    API keys are rejected.

    **Signature Format:**
    ```
    t=timestamp,v1=HMAC-SHA256(timestamp + "." + JSON(payload), signing_secret)
    ```
    
    **Event Types:**
    - `compression`: Counted for billing
    - `error`: Logged only
    - `startup`/`shutdown`: Operational
    
    **Idempotency:**
    Same batch_id within 24h returns success without reprocessing. A batch
    with failed events stays replayable: retry it and already-billed events
    are returned as status "duplicate" (never billed twice).

IdentityManifest.title: IdentityManifest
IdentityManifest.description:
On-prem identity manifest, sent in each upload for rebirth detection.

The on-prem instance persists this manifest in ``/data/identity.json``
HMAC-bound to the api_key on first authenticated request. Subsequent
uploads carry the same values. If we see a *new* ``instance_id`` or an
earlier ``created_at`` for the same api_key, it signals that the operator
deleted the local manifest — typically an attempt to reset a per-instance
grace period or quota.

identity.description: Signed on-prem identity manifest. Optional — older on-prem builds (< 1.1.0) don't send it. When present, the platform logs identity changes (instance_id or created_at moving) for audit. Future versions will block on mismatch.

signing_secret.title: Signing Secret
signing_secret.description: Signing secret for HMAC verification (include on first request only)

events_rejected.title: Events Rejected
events_rejected.description: Events outside the reporting window; will never be billed

signing_secret_registered.title: Signing Secret Registered
signing_secret_registered.description: Whether the signing_secret in this request is now stored. Cache 'registered' only on an explicit true - null also means an older server that predates this field, so treating null as success is the very bug this field exists to fix. Anything else means keep sending the secret on subsequent batches, because the server has nothing to verify future uploads against and they will 401.

signing_secret_error.title: Signing Secret Error
signing_secret_error.description: Machine-readable reason registration did not happen. 'hash_owned_by_other_account': this deployment is using a signing secret belonging to a different account - usually a cloned data volume - and only an operator can clear it, so do not retry on it. 'not_attempted_duplicate_batch': idempotent replay, the next batch will register. 'registration_failed': transient, retry.

events_duplicate.description: Compression events skipped because an earlier delivery of this batch already billed them (replay protection)

TelemetryEvent.title: TelemetryEvent
TelemetryEvent.description:
Single telemetry event from on-prem instance.

The optional ``event_hmac`` field is the per-event integrity tag computed
by the on-prem instance at insert time using HMAC-SHA256(api_key, canonical_event_bytes).
Older on-prem builds (< 1.1.0) don't send it; newer builds always do. The
platform verifies it server-side and rejects events with a bad tag —
closing the in-flight SQLite tamper window.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Echo of the on-prem event ID

status.title: Status
status.description: Billing outcome: billed | recorded_unbilled | failed | duplicate

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Reason code when status is not 'billed'

TelemetryEventResult.title: TelemetryEventResult
TelemetryEventResult.description:
Per-event billing outcome, echoed back to the on-prem appliance.

- ``billed``: cost was charged through the standard billing pipeline
  (prepaid wallet deduction or postpaid enterprise accumulation).
- ``recorded_unbilled``: usage was recorded but not charged; ``reason``
  carries the code (e.g. INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS,
  ENTERPRISE_CREDIT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, DEMO_SCOPE).
- ``failed``: the event was not recorded (e.g. EVENT_HMAC_INVALID,
  RECORDING_FAILED, INTERNAL_ERROR).
- ``duplicate``: the event was already billed by an earlier delivery of
  this batch (replay) and was skipped — not billed and not re-recorded.
